description: SEE THE FINAL PICTURE of a post before you hand it over: returns the image the post will publish (its rendered template PNG or its uploaded photo) as an image you can look at, reduced to about 1000 px. Use it on every draft you make or edit, to check the photo shows what the text says, the headline fits, the coloured words are the right ones and nothing covers the logo; fix and look again before telling the person it is ready. It never creates or changes anything. A template design that was never rendered has no picture yet (409 not_rendered): it renders when the person saves it in the app editor or approves it.

id.description: The post id (a draft, a post in review or a sent one).

max.description: Long side in px (default 1000). Ask for more only to read small text.

name: viralhunt_render_preview
